description: If the user ends up on /console after sign-up (redirect_url lost, which could not be tested here because Clerk is unset), the onboarding card gives no sign that an agent is waiting for approval and offers no 'Enter the code from your agent' action. The user must go back to the terminal and re-open the link, or type /connect by hand.
expected: Console onboarding includes an 'Enter the code your agent printed' link to /connect, so a pending login can be completed from the console.
actual: Only 'Create your first drive'; /connect is not linked anywhere in the console.
suggested_fix: Add 'Have a code from your agent? Enter it' to the empty-state card and the Agents tab; pass redirect_url through Clerk sign-up links.

description: The invalid-code message 'Enter the code in the form XXXX-XXXX.' is shown above the code field, and does not explain the rule that actually failed (codes contain consonants only, so vowels and digits are rejected).
expected: Inline message next to or below the field naming the rule: 'Codes use consonants only, for example BKQD-MWRT.'
actual: Generic format hint above the field.
suggested_fix: Move the notice below the field and show an example code.
